description: FIELD-PROVEN 2026-08-26: SubagentStart/SubagentStop/PostToolUse:Agent all dispatch in Cowork with agent_type exactly 'punch-subagent:punch-researcher', and the [[punch-hooks]] displayContent banner renders in the chat UI (prepended to the next assistant reply -- that placement is inherent to MessageDisplay). systemMessage leaves NO trace on this surface (not rendered, not transcribed) and is no longer used anywhere here. Layout: hook-probe.ps1 on the three probe events logs each dispatch to $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/hook-probe.log (machine-local) AND to <session project dir>/<session_id>/hook-probe.log -- the dir the session exporter zips, so the hook trail appears in every export and Log Lens renders it as a log file -- and queues a banner tracer; the MessageDisplay entry drains the queue into the banner (display-only: model and transcript never see it). show-subagent-final.ps1 (scoped matcher, now proven correct) banners a 220-char excerpt of the subagent's final message and writes the full text to <session dir>/subagent-final-messages.log. PURE POWERSHELL host commands -- no python, no sh: Cowork runs hooks on the Windows host. Disable echo with EPLUS_NO_SUBAGENT_ECHO=1.
